notes.title: Update Demo Version
notes.notes:
Fixes v0.50

-GUI disappears when dying and passing levels.
-Squirrel nut does not kill when opening the door.
-Thank you screen now shows the respective button to press.
-Text of the initial level now appears when the Portuguese language is selected.
-Stage 3: adjusted level design of the screen.

News
-Timer in the Levels.
-Statistics at the end of the screen.
-Addition of a new level.

notes.title: Super Arter - Demo Version is out now!
notes.notes:
Hello!

We have some exciting news to share with you all - the Super Arter demo has just out now!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44849411/2320c1e9941e73b960b049bb3d31f1b761f00992.png

Some features of the full version are disabled. Such as the Life count, Scores, and the benefits you gain when collecting all the gifts in the stage.

We would love to hear your feedback on this demo! Feel free to leave your feedback via email: caio@atuate.com or on our Discord servers: https://discord.gg/NbxrsvUpQZ .

You can also take screenshots of the game and share it on Twitter(X) or Instagram and tag us. We will repost! Instagram: @atuatestudio Twitter(X): https://x.com/atuate .
